方法 · HADDOCK 分數與叢集

blocks.en: Every run below reports a HADDOCK score, and the score means less than its precision suggests. This applies to the whole page, so it is stated once here instead of repeated in each record.

blocks.zh: 下面每一次運算都會報告 HADDOCK 分數，而這個分數的意義比它的精確度看起來要少。這一點適用於整頁，所以在此說明一次，不在每一筆記錄裡重複。

blocks.en: This series is the one place in the project where the scoring function is measuring the variable under test, and the record should say so plainly. The methodology audit on July 30 found the HADDOCK score across BoPep4 variants 93% explainable by peptide length and net charge alone, and that its correlation with Pearce's measured activities is rho ≈ +0.05, where zero is no relationship. A truncation ladder changes length and net charge at every rung: 23 residues at +4.1 down to 15 residues at +2.1.

blocks.zh: 這一系列是整個專案裡唯一一處，評分函數量到的就是受測的那個變數，而記錄應當把這點直說。7 月 30 日的方法稽核發現，BoPep4 各變異體之間的 HADDOCK 分數有 93% 單憑胜肽長度與淨電荷就能解釋，而它與 Pearce 所測活性的相關係數 rho ≈ +0.05，其中零代表沒有關係。截短系列的每一階都在改變長度與淨電荷：從 23 個殘基、+4.1，一路到 15 個殘基、+2.1。

blocks.en: So the ladder's score differences are being produced by the two quantities the audit identified as the score's actual content, and a monotone trend across the ladder would be uninformative no matter which direction it ran. A second case is sharper, because it is a failure, not a confound. The K8Q+K18R double collapses on PEPR1 by every geometric measure available: AF3 ipTM 0.49 against 0.75 to 0.89 for the rest of the panel, interface PAE 9.45 Å against 1.62 to 2.78 Å, the fewest receptor contacts at 42, nine hydrogen bonds against 16 to 21 elsewhere, and a position-18 anchor that has slipped off Asp320 onto Glu296 at a broken 3.42 Å.

blocks.zh: 所以這個系列裡的分數差異，是由稽核指認為分數真正內容的那兩個量所產生的；不論趨勢往哪個方向走，整個系列上的單調趨勢都不帶訊息。第二個例子更明確，因為它是一次失敗，而不是一個混淆。K8Q+K18R 雙突變在 PEPR1 上，以所有可取得的幾何指標衡量都崩掉了：AF3 ipTM 為 0.49，而面板上其餘的是 0.75 到 0.89；介面 PAE 為 9.45 Å，其餘是 1.62 到 2.78 Å；受體接觸數最少，只有 42 個；氫鍵九條，別處是 16 到 21 條；而第 18 位的錨點已從 Asp320 滑到 Glu296，落在斷裂的 3.42 Å。

blocks.en: HADDOCK scores that complex −194.7, which sits inside the −187 to −218 band occupied by the nine healthy complexes. The matrix logs it as DISCORDANT-HADDOCK-rescues. The function looked at a mis-registered interface with half the hydrogen bonds and called it normal. Two consequences follow, and both are already in the methodology. The score is interpretable within a protocol and not across ligands. The alanine scan is the favorable case: same receptor, same restraints, same length, same charge, one side chain removed from one fixed pose, so a score difference has nowhere else to come from.

blocks.en: The ladder is the unfavorable case, which is why the cliffs are reported as a hypothesis about which residues matter and not as a measurement of how much binding is lost. And it is why the load-bearing evidence moved. Where the cliff claim now rests is geometry and occupancy, not score: the salt-bridge inventory showing which bridges dissolve at which cut, and then contact occupancy over 30 ns showing which of those bridges were held and not sampled.

blocks.en: The BoPep4 interface map was built from one validated docking pose: residues buried, salt bridges measured, contacts listed at a 4.5 Å cutoff. It says which side chains sit against PEPR1. It cannot say what the interface loses if one is removed, and by late July that was the question the engineering panel needed answered, because every proposed substitution and every truncation was about to assume a position was expendable.

blocks.zh: BoPep4 的介面圖譜是從一個經驗證的對接姿態建起來的：埋藏的殘基、量到的鹽橋、以 4.5 Å 為截斷列出的接觸。它能說出哪些側鏈貼著 PEPR1。它無法說出移走其中一條時介面會失去什麼，而到了 7 月下旬，這正是工程面板需要答案的問題，因為每一個提出的取代、每一次截短，都即將假定某個位置是可以捨棄的。

blocks.en: An alanine scan answers it with a perturbation, not a measurement. Delete one side chain, let the complex relax, record what the energy function says, and repeat at every position. The ranking that comes out is produced by a method sharing no assumptions with a burial calculation, so agreement between them is evidence and disagreement is a question. Eighteen single-point mutants, Ser6 through the C-terminal Asn23, were built on the validated native-mode complex instead of being predicted from scratch: side-chain atoms beyond Cβ deleted, backbone and Cα-Cβ geometry held fixed.

blocks.zh: 丙胺酸掃描是用擾動、而不是量測來回答這個問題。刪掉一條側鏈，讓複合體鬆弛，記下能量函數怎麼說，再在每個位置重複一次。產出的排名來自一個與埋藏面積計算不共用任何假設的方法，所以兩者一致就是證據，不一致就是一個問題。十八個單點突變體，從 Ser6 到 C 端的 Asn23，是在經驗證的原生模式複合體上建起來的，而不是從頭預測：刪除 Cβ 之外的側鏈原子，骨架與 Cα-Cβ 幾何保持固定。

blocks.en: Mutating on a fixed pose is what isolates the cost of the substitution; re-docking each mutant would have let it find an unrelated register and returned a number about that instead. All 19 systems, 18 mutants plus an unmutated baseline reused from trunc1-23_PEPR1, went through identical HADDOCK 2.5 water refinement at 40/10/10 with the same restraints, so score differences are attributable to the mutation. Electrostatic and van der Waals terms were kept separate, to tell a lost salt bridge from lost packing, and peptide backbone deviation was recorded as a pose metric independent of the score.

結果主要結果6 項發現

blocks.en: Eight hotspots that fail the same way. K7, R9, R11, E12, H14, K18, H22 and N23 clear +7 on both metrics, and every one is carried by a large positive ΔEelec, from +32.6 at H14 to +150.4 at K18, with ΔEvdw flat or favorable throughout. That is the signature of removing a charged side chain from a salt bridge, and it rules out a packing artifact introduced by the mutagenesis. K18A and K7A are the largest hits. K7A is also the only mutant that moves the peptide, by 1.62 Å, so it costs binding energy and pose retention together.

blocks.en: Asn23 ranks last of the eight hotspots. N23A is +9.5, which sits oddly against Asn23 having the largest buried surface at 170 Å² and four hydrogen bonds. The explanation the data support is that several of those contacts engage the C-terminal carboxylate and backbone amide, not the side-chain atoms an Asn to Ala substitution removes, so part of the clamp survives. That distinction is what the C-terminal tag question turned on later: substituting at position 23 keeps the chain terminus, appending to it does not.

blocks.zh: Asn23 在八個熱點中排最後。N23A 為 +9.5，這與 Asn23 擁有最大的埋藏表面 170 Å² 和四條氫鍵放在一起顯得奇怪。數據支持的解釋是：其中幾個接觸牽涉的是 C 端羧基與骨架醯胺，而不是 Asn 換成 Ala 所移走的側鏈原子，所以這個夾持有一部分保留下來。這個區別正是後來 C 端標籤問題的關鍵：在第 23 位做取代會保住鏈的末端，往上接東西則不會。

blocks.en: Ser15 and Ser16 disagree with their own conservation. Both are invariant across all 16 characterized Pep-family sequences and were assigned as core hydrogen-bonded contacts. Neither registers, at −1.3 and −8.0. A serine hydroxyl contributes little to an electrostatic term next to a full salt bridge, so the conservation is real and this assay is not positioned to explain it.

blocks.en: The scan would not have found either control. S15A and G17A were ordered as loss-of-function controls, on published activities roughly 100-fold and more than 4000-fold below wild type. The scan returns −1.3 and −2.9 at exactly those positions. A method that misses the two substitutions the published work shows matter most is a method whose silence elsewhere has no weight, which is the same conclusion the July audit of HADDOCK and AlphaFold3 reached by a different route.

The hypothesis floated before the run, that the prolines would show the same signature from losing backbone rigidity, failed: P10A, P13A and P19A sit at 0.75 to 1.03 Å, inside the neutral range.

blocks.en: The binding site is closed and the construct is open. Eight positions are protected as binding-critical, and five more, S15, S16, G17, G20 and G21, are protected on conservation grounds even without a score penalty. With the C terminus already off-limits, the surface left to engineer is the construct and the delivery. Every subsequent design decision in the project sits there.

blocks.en: Direct evidence now sits under the secretion handle. S6, K8, P10, P13 and P19 are neutral on both metrics. K8 is the residue the K8Q and K8E secretion designs modify, and until this sprint that choice rested on the burial map alone. The project's limiting problem is secretion efficiency, so a free handle at K8 is a project-level result and not a structural footnote.

blocks.en: The truncation direction was set here. Flat response at S6, plus the map's finding that residues 1 to 6 make no contact, pointed at the N terminus as the removable end. Given the biomanufacturing strategy, the gain was taken as truncation instead of substitution, which produced the ladder and then the 9-23 construct: a third less mass, one trypsin-type site instead of three, half the positive charge, so less of it binding electrostatically to the producer cells.

blocks.en: K18R had a rationale, and losing it cost nothing. K18 has the largest electrostatic contribution in the peptide, which made a conservative Lys to Arg swap attractive. MD later found the Lys18 contact with Asp348 present in 53.7% of frames over a 2.55 to 9.37 Å swing, and Phe371 nearest Gly20 and not Lys18. Position 18 still matters; the structural claim underneath K18R does not, and it was not ordered. Because the engineering target had already moved to the construct, withdrawing it removed nothing from the panel.

blocks.en: PEPR2 is not covered. Existing data show PEPR2 with a degraded mid-belt where Arg11 and Glu12 lose their partners, so R11A and E12A may behave differently there. A PEPR2 scan has not been run, and dual-receptor engagement is a ReLEAF-level claim, so it stays open.

blocks.en: The alanine scan had just established which positions the interface cannot lose, and by implication which it can: S6, K8, P10, P13 and P19 neutral on both metrics, with the map putting residues 1 to 6 outside the contact region entirely. That licenses editing the N terminus. It does not tell you where to cut. The distinction matters because a substitution and a truncation are not the same experiment. A point mutation removes one side chain and leaves the chain.

blocks.en: A truncation removes residues, shortens the peptide, changes its net charge, and moves the N terminus to a new residue that now bears a free α-amino group. Which consequence dominates could not be predicted, so the series was run as a ladder: cut at successive points, score each one on the same protocol, and find where the interface stops tolerating it. Two things made this the sprint the project needed, not a curiosity.

blocks.en: The published work already reports the 9-23 core retaining activity within a factor of ten, so a short form was known to be viable and the question was only which short form. And the manufacturing case was strong enough that if the binding cost were tolerable, the decision was already made. The ladder existed to find out whether it was tolerable, and where.

blocks.en: The anchor belt lies downstream of the cut. The atlas established the architecture the ladder is cutting into: an extended peptide clipped into an acidic LRR groove by a three-point salt-bridge belt at Arg9, Lys7/Lys8 and position 18, with the buried Asn23 anchor at the end. The first belt residue is Lys7. Shaving the N terminus removes only Gly1 to Leu3, which make no anchor contact, and the belt is retained intact in every truncated complex.

blocks.zh: 錨點帶位於切點的下游。圖集確立了這個系列正在切入的結構：一條伸展的胜肽，由 Arg9、Lys7/Lys8 與第 18 位構成的三點鹽橋帶夾進酸性的 LRR 凹槽，末端則是埋藏的 Asn23 錨點。帶上的第一個殘基是 Lys7。削掉 N 端只移除 Gly1 到 Leu3，而這幾個不形成任何錨點接觸，所以在每一個截短的複合體中，這條帶都完整保留。

blocks.en: Removing the anchorless N terminus costs nothing measurable. The shallow cuts keep position 18 on its canonical partner and come out ahead of both substitutions on AF3 confidence, which is the structural license for treating N-terminal length as an engineering axis. Those numbers sit in the Δ1-2, Δ1-3 record instead of being repeated here.

blocks.en: The series then moved past them. Δ1-2 and Δ1-3 were the July finalists and were not ordered; the cut moved further down the ladder to 9-23, with 7-23 alongside it, on manufacturing grounds and not on a binding result.

blocks.zh: 接著這一系列越過了它們。Δ1-2 與 Δ1-3 是 7 月的入選者，但沒有被訂製；切點沿著系列往下移到 9-23，旁邊還有 7-23，理由是製造，不是結合上的結果。

blocks.en: MD located the boundary, and then moved it. The wild-type run put the fluctuation break at the same residue the ladder's cliff falls on: Gly1 fluctuating by 3.51 Å, everything from Glu12 onward under 1.0 Å, and Arg9 at the boundary with an RMSF of 1.32 Å, a mean closest approach of 2.79 Å and 100% contact occupancy. Two methods with no shared assumptions landed on Arg9. The truncation runs then complicated it: clamp integrity is 100.0% for 1-23, 98.5% for 7-23 and 99.9% for 15-23, but 77.1% for 9-23. The cliff is real and it is not where length predicts, because 9-23 keeps the 9-14 segment while removing the Lys7-Asp129 salt bridge that anchors it, and 15-23 removes both together. Shorter is not worse; losing an anchor without the segment it anchors is worse. Project

結果專案3 項發現

blocks.en: The production molecule came out of this series. 9-23 is the manufacturing candidate and the construct already in hand as D-01 and D-04. Against full length it has 33% less mass, 1612.73 Da against 2409.74 Da, one trypsin-type cut site instead of three, and half the positive charge at +2.1 against +4.1, so less of it sticks electrostatically to the producer cells. It also removes the greasy GILI front segment, which is the part that raises a self-toxicity risk in Bacillus subtilis, where no amount of promoter tuning would recover the yield. The cost is the published factor of ten in activity. It costs nothing to settle at the bench. Both lengths were ordered, 9-23 as D-01 and D-04 and full length as D-03 and D-05, so the head-to-head expression comparison can already be run in one sitting. That is the clearest example in the project of a dry lab result shaped so the wet lab can decide it.

blocks.en: Engineering moved away from the binding site. With the C terminus off-limits and the eight hotspots protected, N-terminal length was the only axis left that changes the molecule's manufacturability without touching the interface. The truncation series is what established that axis, and the later tag-placement result depends on it: the N terminus is the end that flaps and the end the ladder shows is removable, so it is where a tag can sit without touching a contact.

blocks.en: Nothing computational separated the rungs, so the whole ladder was sent. 7-23 is more stable than 9-23 on every MD metric recorded, with clamp integrity 98.5% against 77.1%, Asn23-Arg487 99.9% against 81.1%, and 151 receptor contacts against 129, while 9-23 is the cheaper molecule to make. 15-23, 9-23, 7-23 and full length all went to the bench as one series, so the measured concentration settles a question the dry lab could not.

17 條序列的 Pep 家族比對 · 鏈末端化學

blocks.en: The alanine scan and the truncation ladder both ask what the receptor needs. The alignment asks what the peptide family keeps, which is a different and cheaper question: every position that is invariant across a family has been held there by selection, and selection sees the whole job, not only docking. That was needed because the methods in hand had failed on exactly this axis. The July 30 audit found the HADDOCK score 93% explainable by length and charge and uncorrelated with measured activity, and AF3 unable to separate BoPep4 from a peptide more than 4000-fold dead.

blocks.en: Conservation is the one line of evidence in the sprint that is independent of both, since it is observation and not prediction. Tandem repeats were the same week's second question. If a single copy engages one receptor, two copies on one chain might engage two, and for a production platform a potency gain per molecule secreted is worth more than a binding gain.

blocks.en: The conserved region stops at 20, not 23. 15 to 23 had been described as the conserved block. The alignment supports an invariant SSG at 15 to 17 and an invariant Gly at 20, with 21, 22 and 23 variable. BoPEP4's own Gly21 is a minority residue at that position.

blocks.en: Asn23 is not invariant in this set. All seven characterized AtPEPs have Asn there, and so does BoPEP4, but five of the nine Brassica entries do not: BnPep4_E5L6 has Ser, BnPep6_DM88 has Asp, and the three Pep1 orthologs end in His. BnPep4_E5L6 is BoPEP4's closest relative at two differences. The defensible sentence is that Asn23 is invariant across the characterized AtPEP set and 12 of 17 in the Brassica-inclusive alignment, which is not what the pages currently say.

blocks.en: The invariant positions are the ones the docking score ignores. This is the finding that ties the sprints together. The alanine scan returned −1.3, −8.0, −2.9 and −3.9 at S15, S16, G17 and G20: no penalty at any of the four positions the family has never changed. Published work puts S15A at roughly 100-fold and G17A at more than 4000-fold weaker, and Tang reports G20A harmless while G20I kills binding. So the invariant block is held by selection for something a binding-energy refinement does not measure, most likely backbone register or a step after engagement. Conservation and docking score are answering different questions, and the conserved block is where they visibly disagree.

blocks.en: Tandem repeats cannot work for this peptide, on chemistry. Only the final copy in a tandem chain has a free C-terminal carboxylate. In every upstream copy that carboxylate is consumed into the peptide bond joining it to the next copy, and that carboxylate is what salt-bridges Arg487 at 100% occupancy inside a 0.54 Å window. An n-copy construct therefore contains n−1 copies that cannot engage, which is the same mechanism that kills a C-terminal His tag. The groove compounds it: Asn23 sits buried in a pocket at the end of the run with no exit channel, so there is nowhere for a linker to thread out. A linker placed further upstream to avoid that lands inside the invariant 15 to 20 block.

結果專案4 項發現

blocks.en: Multivalency is closed as a potency route. Yield per liter and length per molecule are the levers that remain, which is where the truncation decision came from. No tandem construct is in the panel, and this is the reason to give.

blocks.zh: 多價性作為提升效力的路線已經關閉。剩下的槓桿是每公升的產量與每個分子的長度，而截短的決定就是從這裡來的。面板中沒有任何串聯構築，而這就是要給的理由。

blocks.en: A second independent route reaches the same tag conclusion. The tandem argument and the 6xHis result rest on one chemical fact about chain ends. The codon-optimized cassettes designed in June and July append CATCATCATCATCATCAT directly after the mature peptide, so the tag sits on exactly that carboxylate; the constructs ordered after August 16 have the tag at the N terminus instead. Two analyses reaching it by different routes is why tag placement moved to the front instead of being treated as a modeling caveat.

blocks.en: Support for the crop-range claim. BrPep4_A5G1 differs from BoPEP4 by one residue and BnPep4_E5L6 by two, so the Brassica Pep4 orthologs are effectively the same molecule. A peptide designed for one Brassica crop is not obviously specific to it, which is the in-silico support under the crop-range experiment.

blocks.en: A second question travels with tag placement and was settled separately: whether a spacer is needed between the tag and the mature protein. The concern is that an N-terminal tag sits next to the signal-peptidase cleavage site, so it could move the site or lower the confidence of the cut, and a short neutral spacer is the conventional insurance against that. SignalP 6.0 answers it directly, and the test was run as paired submissions: seven N-His designs, each submitted once without a spacer and once with one, fourteen sequences in total. These were the LEA14 constructs, not the peptide ones, and the result is reported here because it is what settled the question for the tag.

blocks.zh: 有第二個問題與標籤位置一起出現，並且是分開解決的：標籤與成熟蛋白之間是否需要一段間隔序列。顧慮在於，N 端標籤緊鄰訊號肽酶的切位，因此可能把切位移動，或降低切割的信心值，而一段短的中性間隔序列是對此的慣用保險。SignalP 6.0 直接回答了這個問題，而測試是以成對送件的方式執行：七個 N-His 設計，每一個各送一次不帶間隔序列、一次帶間隔序列，總共十四條序列。這些是 LEA14 的構築，不是胜肽的，而結果列在這裡，因為它正是為標籤解決這個問題的依據。
結果主要結果4 項發現

blocks.en: The spacer earns nothing, so there is none in the constructs. All fourteen sequences return Sec/SPI at 0.998 to 0.999 with the cleavage site between positions 35 and 36, and every pair agrees: the spacer never moves the site, and it shifts the cleavage probability by at most 0.002, from 0.9709 to 0.9745 across the whole set. Fourteen submissions to show seven were unnecessary is a cheap way to retire a worry, and the paired design is what makes the negative readable and not an absence of evidence.

blocks.en: The C-terminal tag scores best and places worst. C-His returns the best HADDOCK score anywhere in the nine-run set at −138.4, and the largest buried areas at 2260–2582 Å². It also reaches only the same CAPRI ceiling as the rest. A tag that adds surface adds score, which is the confound the methodology audit describes.

blocks.en: BAK1 is the shared co-receptor that completes PEPR1 as it completes FLS2, EFR and BRI1, so the angle was worth testing: can the modeled peptide–receptor interaction be accommodated in a three-body complex. Docking all three bodies at once was attempted and did not run. What exists instead is a two-body dock, with the PEPR1–BoPEP4 complex frozen as one body and BAK1 docked onto it, restrained on 15 of the 24 BAK1 residues transferred from 4MN8.

blocks.en: The angle was considered and not taken further. Freezing the binary complex fixes the peptide register before the co-receptor is placed, so the model cannot show that the three components mutually arrange, only that BAK1 can be accommodated against a fixed one. The output was compared against the FLS2–flg22–BAK1 crystal by eye and not by superposition, and the run was not analyzed beyond that. It is recorded here because the co-receptor question was asked, not because it was answered.

blocks.en: Docking was the obvious method and it was rejected on the chemistry. ACC deaminase is a pyridoxal-5′-phosphate enzyme of fold type II, and its cofactor is not a guest in the active site: PLP is held as an internal aldimine, a covalent bond to the ε-amino nitrogen of Lys51. The substrate then displaces Lys51 to form an external aldimine, so it too is covalent before catalysis begins. A docking search returns the best non-covalent pose, which is a pose this enzyme never adopts. Every atom below is placed by superposition onto an experimental structure instead.

blocks.en: The four ACC deaminase designs all rest on one question the sequence can answer more cheaply than a structure can: which positions has the family held fixed. ConSurf was run in ConSeq mode on the Q5PWZ8 wild-type sequence, searching UniRef90 with MMseqs2, removing redundancy with CD-HIT at 95%, aligning with MAFFT and rating by the Bayesian method, returning 150 homologs, and the grades were then read against distance and burial for the eight candidate positions.

blocks.en: Alanine is cheaper than serine at all six cysteines. By +0.02 to +1.06 kcal·mol−1, with the margin growing with burial. Cys196 is the only cysteine where nothing passes the cutoff. C162A is the cheapest Cys→Ala at −0.26 and is also the one variant with published experimental support, Murakami et al. 1997 reporting activity unaffected. The same paper reports that chemical modification of that thiol abolishes activity outright, and that C162G and C162V raise Km for ACC without changing kcat much. The side chain at 162 takes part in substrate binding, so C162S, bulkier and polar, poses more Km risk than C162A does, and both are run.

Km sits at 0.8 to 3.4 mM against a rhizosphere ACC pool in the sub-micromolar range, so the enzyme is always first order in substrate and the rate goes as the amount of active enzyme present. blocks.en: ViennaRNA was used on the assumption that reducing mRNA secondary-structure stability around the MF001 ribosome binding site (RBS) and the start codon improves ribosome attachment. Translation performance was assessed with minimum free energy (MFE) values and unpaired-probability predictions, alongside codon adaptation index (CAI) values taken against Bacillus subtilis 168 codon-usage data from the Kazusa database. The approach follows Castillo-Hair et al. 2019 on optogenetic control of B. subtilis gene expression, which the CcaSR system here is built on.

blocks.en: All analyses ran on the RS-inclusive Window A, which models the pre-recombination transient mRNA state: RS (28 nt) + MF001 RBS (24 nt) + A spacer (1 nt) + SamyQ signal peptide (93 nt) + CDS first 90 nt. MFE is the free energy of the most stable secondary structure. start+15 and start+30 are the mean unpaired probability over the first 15 or 30 nucleotides from the ATG. SD core is the mean unpaired probability over the 7-nucleotide Shine-Dalgarno core, AAGGAGG.

blocks.en: Phase 1 held the 93-nt SamyQ sequence static and recoded only the first 15 codons (45 nt) of each passenger gene independently, from a library of 8000 random synonymous candidates, scored on a balance metric bal = start+15 + SD core. Phase 2 addressed elongation through CAI against the host matrix and appended a C-terminal 6xHis purification tag, but full-length optimization degraded translation initiation by lowering start+15. Phase 3 departed from standard host codon adaptation by making SamyQ codons 2 to 31 editable, which reduced secondary-structure stability around the initiation site further and increased accessibility.

blocks.en: Cloning the constructs with the MF001 RBS proved difficult, so the construct was changed to the STK EEBD-RBS0 part, which places RiboJ, a self-cleaving hammerhead ribozyme insulator, upstream of RBS0. RBS0 has the same Shine-Dalgarno core (AAGGAGG) as MF001 and sits 6 nt from the start codon against MF001's 8 nt, both inside the Bacillus subtilis optimum, and every recoded codon lies downstream of the ATG. On that reasoning the prediction was that the ranking should survive the part swap.

blocks.en: Limitations. ViennaRNA diagnoses translation initiation only, and only for the processed mRNA, so a higher start+15 or SD core identifies a construct worth testing and does not predict yield. P(unpaired) is a proxy for ribosome accessibility and does not capture co-transcriptional folding, ribosome unwinding or RNase processing, so the ranking between designs is more reliable than any single value. It also does not capture secretion efficiency, SRP targeting, co-translational export, or degradation by extracytoplasmic HtrA/HtrB, which matters particularly for disordered proteins such as LEA14. The 50 000 variants are a sample and not an optimum, the cleavage position is assumed and not sourced, and the orientation finding should be confirmed against the source plasmid.
